calculation_handling.description: Where the zone label carries an 'f' value, that value (metres) is the required minimum lot frontage.
Where the zone label has no 'f' value, the required minimum lot frontage is 6.0 m.

evidence.townhouse: for a townhouse with every dwelling unit
evidence.all_units_front_street: every dwelling unit fronting directly on a street

calculation_handling.description: Measurement rule for the frontage required by (A) or (B): for a semi-detached house it is required per dwelling unit; for a townhouse with every unit fronting a street it is required per dwelling unit and reduced by 1.0 m for each unit without an individual private driveway leading to its front.
calculation_handling.gaps: Modifies the (A)/(B) value rather than setting its own bound; the per-unit multiplication and the 1.0 m per-unit reduction depend on the unit count and on how many units lack an individual driveway, which has no DSL input, so no expression is written. The 1.0 m reduction is listed as a cross-reference adjustment for lack of a closer reason. The lot conditions are arm-specific (townhouse arm only), so they are recorded in application, not as a conjunctive condition.

units.disclosure: For semi-detached houses and street-fronting townhouses, the minimum frontage applies to each unit (townhouse units without their own driveway get 1.0 m less). We do not yet calculate this per-unit frontage.

calculation_handling.description: Despite (A)-(C), a lot with a townhouse having one or more dwelling units not fronting directly on a street requires a minimum lot frontage of 30.0 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: The trigger is the negation of the all_units_front_street token, which the condition grammar cannot express (no negated token); condition is left 'none' and the arm applies only to townhouses where some unit does not front a street, which needs the user's layout. 'despite (A), (B) and (C)' is a within-regulation precedence and is not keyed as a displacement.

units.disclosure: A townhouse lot where any unit does not face the street needs at least 30.0 m of frontage. We need your proposed layout to know whether this applies.

10.10.30.20(1).explanation: In the R zone, the minimum lot frontage is the 'f' number on the zoning map label, or 6.0 m if the label has none. For semi-detached houses and street-fronting townhouses that minimum applies to each unit (townhouse units without their own driveway need 1.0 m less). A townhouse lot with any unit not facing the street needs at least 30.0 m.
